supporting_observations.claim: At 13:48 UTC, tess.hart launched Active Directory Users and Computers (dsa.msc) in a high-integrity process on WS-THART-01.
That MMC process connected to the domain controller's LDAP port 389 and endpoint mapper port 135 shortly after launch.
The directory-management activity is consistent with account administration, but the records do not show that it created guest.rwong or changed any account.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records contain no explicit domain account-creation event identifying guest.rwong.
The provided records contain no evidence of the new account's group memberships, privileges, or subsequent use.
The observed directory-management process is timestamped 13:48 UTC, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 UTC time.
claims_not_established: Whether guest.rwong was actually created during the review window.
Who created the account and whether the action was authorized.
Whether the account was added only to Volunteers or granted other group memberships or privileges.
Whether the 13:48 UTC Active Directory Users and Computers activity was related to the alerted account.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain controller security and directory audit events for the review window, including account creation and group-membership changes, with the affected account and actor.
The account's current and historical group memberships, privileges, creation time, and other relevant directory attributes.
Any help-desk request, approval, or ticket associated with guest.rwong.
Relevant authentication and logon records for tess.hart and guest.rwong around and after the reported creation time.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect's UI was launched on WS-THART-01 by tess.hart. The inventory states there is no VPN; this launch alone does not establish a VPN connection and does not decide the account alert. Review separately if appropriate. (T278-00036, T278-00037, T278-00038)

An Explorer UserAssist registry value references a ROT13-encoded path that decodes to a Mozilla Firefox executable path. This is outside the account-creation alert and does not establish malicious activity. (T278-00047)
